subject: RM_RearingVenomvine
departures: canes are black, not green or brown, with no leaves, thorns, flowers or berries shown
the stand rears straight up as one flat fan of canes, not a tangled rounded thicket
the undersides of the canes carry pale, bone-like bands across a black upper surface
when at rest the canes lie low in long parallel sweeps all angled the same way, not arching and rooting at random
it stands alone and upright on an open, flat plain with nothing else upright nearby
